## About me

I am an electrical and electronics engineer (ENSEEIHT, Toulouse INP) currently
studying for a Master's degree in Smart Data Science at ENSAI. I enjoy using data and AI
to solve concrete problems, with an engineer's focus on rigour and reproducibility.

## About this portfolio

This book gathers the projects I build during the 2026–2027 academic year of the
Master's programme. Each chapter is a self-contained analysis, compiled from source
with Quarto, versioned with git and run in a pinned environment, so that every
result can be reproduced.

## Contents

- **Chapter 1, Exploratory data analysis**: electricity production, consumption and
  exchanges across French regions, using RTE's éCO2mix open data.
- **Chapters 2 and 3**: projects from the following semesters, added as the year
  goes on.
- **References**: the bibliography cited across the chapters.
